name: Twist-Up Aluminum Mineral Sun Stick
description: A short, stout sun stick with a flat-oval cross-section, built from matte slate-graphite recycled aluminum, closed with a matte bone-white pull-off cap, turned by a bare knurled aluminum dial at the base, and loaded with a chalk-white mineral balm that rises as a flat dome above the tube's opening.
materials: Matte anodized recycled-aluminum flat-oval tube, bare knurled aluminum twist dial at the base, matte bone-white aluminum pull-off cap, dense chalk-white mineral balm
primaryColors: Matte slate-graphite tube, matte bone-white cap, bare silver knurled dial, chalk-white balm
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, wordmark, logo, printing, embossing, or engraving anywhere on the tube, cap, base dial, or balm; never make the tube round in cross-section, it must stay a flat oval; never swap the twist-up dial for a pump, screw closure, or squeeze tube; never tint the mineral balm any color other than chalk white; never make the anodized aluminum glossy or mirror-polished; no props, hands, or presenter in frame. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the flat-oval cross-section, the tube's short stout proportions, the matte slate-graphite anodized finish, the bone-white cap's height and matching oval footprint, and the knurl pitch of the bare aluminum base dial identical and consistent across every angle; whenever the cap is off, the chalk-white balm dome sits at the same raised height above the same crisp oval rim. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
